learning_outcomes.text: Identify and develop skills that are required of a professional, accredited engineer by self- and peer-evaluation
Explain the societal impact and professional responsibility of an engineer
Examine case studies in engineering ethics using engineering principles
Develop a professional ethical identity to carry forward in their working life

syllabus_topics: The benefits and importance of inclusivity from equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Communication skills: written and oral. Group working skills.
Societal and contemporary issues in engineering.
Professional conduct, ethics, and the legal aspects of professional responsibility.
The importance of intellectual property and its protection.

assessment_methods.method: Interactive group session on a Case Study in Engineering Ethics (including presentation)

assessment_rules: Students must gain a summative mark of 40% to pass the module. Students who fail the module at the first attempt will be re-assessed prior to the August diet. This re-assessment will consist entirely of coursework. No marks from any previous attempts will be transferred to a new resit attempt.
